en.name: English
en.title: The MarkItBetter field guide.
en.intro: Workflows, snippets and diagrams for developers who already know Markdown.
en.diagramHelp: Drag to pan. Use Fit All to reset; maximize fills the browser content area. These controls belong to this web guide.
en.availability: Released instructions target v0.49.0. Mermaid is documented separately as upcoming development work.
en.upcomingNotice: Upcoming feature: the reviewed Mermaid work and subsequent viewer revision are not in public v0.49.0.
en.footer: English, Thai and Japanese. Reference theme. Release status checked 4 November 2026.
en.homeNote: Read the released workflow, look up a setting, or prepare a Mermaid document with its availability clearly marked.
en.preferencesNote: Every released Preferences tab, its mode requirements, settings and style controls.
en.mermaidNote: A major chapter covering source, names, viewing, Find, compatibility, international labels and recovery.
en.aboutSourcesText: Released behavior is checked against v0.49.0 source. Reviewed Mermaid development and the next controls revision remain upcoming. This guide describes app behavior; examples use synthetic content.
en.noScript: Interactive controls need JavaScript. All chapters and source examples remain available to read and select.
